crates/xberg-rag/src/flat.rs-57-59 (1)
`57-59`: _🗄️ Data Integrity & Integration_ | _🟡 Minor_ | _⚡ Quick win_ **Reapply store invariants after snapshot decoding.** `decode()` validates the archive structure, not that every chunk vector matches `dim`. Constructing `Self { dim, chunks }` lets malformed-but-decodable snapshots silently enter search, where `zip` truncates mismatched vectors. Rebuild through `Self::new(dim)` plus `ingest(&chunks)`.
Proposed fix ```diff fn load(bytes: &[u8]) -> Result { let (dim, chunks) = crate::snapshot::decode(bytes)?; - Ok(Self { dim, chunks }) + let mut store = Self::new(dim); + store.ingest(&chunks)?; + Ok(store) } ```

crates/xberg-rag/src/snapshot.rs-21-24 (1)
`21-24`: _🗄️ Data Integrity & Integration_ | _🟡 Minor_ | _⚡ Quick win_ **Do not truncate persisted dimensions.** `dim as u32` silently truncates on 64-bit targets. An empty `FlatStore` with a dimension above `u32::MAX` can snapshot successfully and restore with a different dimension. Use `u32::try_from(dim)` and return `RagError::Snapshot` on overflow.
Proposed fix ```diff pub(crate) fn encode(dim: usize, chunks: &[IndexedChunk]) -> Result> { - let body = SnapshotBody { dim: dim as u32, chunks: chunks.to_vec() }; + let dim = u32::try_from(dim) + .map_err(|_| RagError::Snapshot("snapshot dimension exceeds u32::MAX".into()))?; + let body = SnapshotBody { dim, chunks: chunks.to_vec() }; ```
